decisions.machine_status: The machine will be serviced before use

commitments.detail: The machine will be serviced and the worn foot pedal replaced with a new FC-9 hand-operated speed-controller.
Jordan will complete 3 garments using cotton material by September 1, 2026.
Jordan's project will be prioritized for completion by September 1, 2026, followed by Rosa's project.
The work surface height will be set to 75 cm, and Rosa will use the seat while working.
